Here's a draft:

Subject: Confirming transfer-planning meeting, Oct 29 at 2:00 p.m.

Hello,

I'm writing to confirm my transfer-planning meeting on Wednesday, October 29 at 2:00 p.m. I'm looking forward to hearing about the options available to me and am open to whatever direction makes sense.

Could you let me know if there is anything I should bring, such as transcripts, a course list, or notes? If the time needs to change, I'm happy to be flexible, though I have classes MWF mornings and Tuesday/Thursday at 11 a.m., so afternoons would work best.

Thank you so much for your time.

Best,
[your name]
[your student ID, if needed]

Want it shorter?
